meta.title: Mara — Gutenberg / Kadence working sample
meta.author: Mara Digital
meta.description: Six-page fictional consulting demo. Not a client reference. No form submissions or real customer data.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user(1);
$pages = json_decode(base64_decode(''), true);
$menu = wp_create_nav_menu('Demo primary');
foreach ($pages as $i => $item) {
  $id = wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>$item['title'],'post_name'=>$item['slug'],'post_content'=>$item['body'],'post_author'=>1]);
  if (is_wp_error($id)) { throw new Exception($id->get_error_message()); }
  update_post_meta($id,'_kad_post_title','hide');
  if ($item['slug']==='home') { update_option('page_on_front',$id); update_option('show_on_front','page'); }
  wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu,0,['menu-item-object-id'=>$id,'menu-item-object'=>'page','menu-item-type'=>'post_type','menu-item-status'=>'publish','menu-item-title'=>$item['title']]);
}
set_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations',['primary'=>$menu]);
update_option('blogname','MARA / DEMO');
update_option('blogdescription','Fictional consulting working sample');
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/');
update_option('blog_public',0);
update_option('show_admin_bar_front',false);
wp_update_custom_css_post(base64_decode(''));
flush_rewrite_rules();
file_put_contents('/wordpress/mara-demo-verification.json',json_encode(['wordpressVersion'=>get_bloginfo('version'),'theme'=>get_stylesheet(),'themeVersion'=>wp_get_theme()->get('Version'),'kadenceBlockRegistered'=>WP_Block_Type_Registry::get_instance()->is_registered('kadence/advancedheading'),'publishedDemoPages'=>count($pages),'isClientReference'=>false,'formSendsData'=>false]));
